guard: The Codex host checks its turn state again after a role request's take, so a drive sends no turn/start into a turn another client started, and a steer whose own turn ended steers nothing into the next one

mutations.name: a drive checks only for shutdown after its take
mutations.find:
if (shuttingDown || driver.busy || awaitingTurnEnd) return;
        if (items.length === 0 && !turnPeek) return;
mutations.expectRed: 1a the drive sends no turn/start while the other turn runs, and starts one at its boundary
mutations.cell: 1a the drive sends no turn/start while the other turn runs, and starts one at its boundary
mutations.note: A turn the TUI started during the take gets a turn/start sent into it, which app-server refuses or runs beside it.

mutations.name: a steer checks only that some turn is running after its take
mutations.expectRed: 2a nothing is steered into the turn this host did not start
mutations.cell: 2a nothing is steered into the turn this host did not start
mutations.note: The host's turn ended during the take and another client's turn is running, so the request is steered into that turn and then carried again by the boundary drive.
